urdu.name: حمیدہ
urdu.long_meaning: Hamidah (حمیدہ) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم قابلِ تعریف، محمود ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

faq.a: Hamidah is associated with the Arabic form حميدة, whose core sense is praiseworthy, commendable, laudable.

faq.q: What is the origin of Hamidah?
faq.a: Hamidah is associated with Arabic. Hamidah is a transliteration of Arabic حَمِيدَة (Ḥamīda) 'praiseworthy (feminine)', from the root ح م د (ḥ-m-d). The source gloss 'companion, supporter' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.
Yes — the underlying form حميدة is Arabic.
Hamidah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.q: What does Hamidah mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Hamidah is rendered حمیدہ and carries the sense قابلِ تعریف، محمود.

faq.q: What does Hamidah mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Hamidah is rendered حمیده and carries the sense ستوده، پسندیده.
A romanized syllable approximation is ha-mi-dah. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Hamidah?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Hamidah, hamidah. Script forms are حميدة, حميده, حمیده, حمیدہ, हमीदा.

faq.q: Is Hamidah a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
